<thought>Based on the mass (C₆H₁₀O₂, DBE = 2) and IR peaks (OH ~3446 cm⁻¹, carbonyl ~1729 cm⁻¹, C=C ~1656 cm⁻¹), the most consistent isomer is the open‑chain α‑β‑unsaturated ketone with an alcohol: CH₃‑CO‑CH(OH)‑CH=CH₂. Its SMILES is “CC(=O)C(CC=C)O”. This matches the formula, unsaturation count, and functional‑group IR signatures.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)C(CC=C)O</final_answer>
